notes.title: New version 3.3.6 is now released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We have just released a new update 3.3.6 with many new features:
- all game graphics, effects, sounds, ambience and UI just changed to match the style, the atmosphere and the vibes of the best classic shooters we all played and love, while keeping new gen graphics look
- many new fx like the wind dust and smokes in all maps now brings a war field feel
- new adjustment of combined deaths animations and ragdolls at same time to give a better players deaths.
- better and smoother characters animations 
- many small improvements in some maps Level Design

if you like the game give us a review to support us.
Thank you

notes.title: New version 3.2 is now released with a lot of new features
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We have just released a new update 3.2 of the game with a lot of new features:
- added new modes , online mode vs real players & bots, private match with your friends, match solo against bots only
- better look HD graphics
- new faster and better graphics optimizations
- new post screen effects
- new intelligent advanced bots that plays like real players
- added mini map
- added grenade
- added damage indicator
- added game log
- now you can earn both GP and CA by upgrading (level up) in the game
- new localizations
- added ragdoll characters
- animated characters menu
- better UI and sounds in full game
- added better sound and input options
- most visible bugs fixed
- and many other new features that you will discover
- many new maps are coming soon, almost finished we will release them as soon as possible
we invite you to retry the game now, if you like it give us a review to support the game.
Thank you

notes.title: New Update to fix bug left in Default Mouse Sensibility
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We have just released a new update with small fix again on the mouse sensibility that was working not correct in some low performance devices, the bug was the sensibility was too fast or too slow , now its working very good, after you get this update the game will reset the input setting to default, so make sure to put again your custom input controls. Sorry for this bug that was because we was working on both controllers and mouse at same time. and trying to have the best possible result for both.

notes.title: Big performance boost in both the paid and the free demo version
notes.content:
We just updated both the paid and the free demo version with these new features:

- big performance boost: this time its a CPU boost, as we noticed that some old processors had performance drop even with a good graphic card, we just fixed this issue and now the game should works more faster for every one, in older low performant pc, we highly recommend switching to settings->graphics->medium, then try the game, if it still slow, reduce your resolution from settings->resolution
- Updated the player Arms to looks better (a bit dirty and realistic skin)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41208536/a96dca8ee9aa4fdc459e0764c04aa8fd685b8842.png

notes.title: We just updated both the paid and the free demo version
notes.content:
We just updated both the paid and the free demo version with these new features:

- big performance boost: the game now should works more faster for every one, in older low performant pc, we highly recommend switching to settings->graphics->medium, then try the game, if it still slow, reduce your resolution from settings->resolution
- big graphics style change: now the game should looks more shaded, low reflective, low saturated, a bit more contrasted, now looks more better and more realistic then before.
- reduced Recoil of all weapons to half
- Players from free demo now can join players of paid version in same match, 
Note: Players from free demo can't get GP ou in game Cash so limited to default weapons: AKM, M9 Pistol, and Knife
